goal: Eliminate redundant scheduled identity probes by sharing the account proxy keeper lease and 120-second cadence, while keeping fresh deployment preparation and pre-mutation identity proofs unchanged.
context: Follow-up to deployed, full-suite/race-tested and API-reviewed 4790dd7. Canary and global watch prove all eight account identities healthy; socket counters exposed ScheduledStarter.PrepareScheduledAccount bypassing the healthy keeper cadence every schedule tick. Only when economy is enabled for that account, delegate scheduled preparation to MaintainProxyControlPlane; keep flag-off behavior identical. Do not modify prepareDeployment, workflow EnsureFreshNetworkIdentity, lifecycle mutation guards, provider capacity authority, recovery checkpoints, data, or migrations. Add isolated PostgreSQL concurrent-caller regression proving healthy scheduled readiness makes no socket request and never forges last_health_at. Keep lease-based fast recovery for stale/degraded identities. Full suite plus six-package race gate, exact-source API review and scoped checkpoint required. No subagents. Existing 15-minute wire sample is left undisturbed; deploy this follow-up only after it completes, then validate and resample.
commit_message: fix(network): coalesce scheduled account identity maintenance
